Hi Sarah —

Great to hear Appwave is progressing. Thanks for the SKU one-pager. High-level answers:

- Bulk publishing: we support a CSV-based bulk import for catalogue metadata and SKU-level pricing. There are a few required columns (SKU id, product title, cloud target, pricing model, entitlements). We can share a template and validate a staging import before publishing.

- Seller qualification automation: core checks we automate are seller identity verification (via SSO tenant / org ID), basic security attestations (SOC2 existence flag), and SKU metadata completeness. Manual gates typically include contractual entitlements (co-sell commission structure) and any enterprise-specific data residency approvals.

To keep this efficient, I9d suggest the following for the sync:
1) Quick run-through of your SKU CSV (10m)
2) Walk through the automated validation results we surface (10m)
3) Ops & legal gating items and timelines (15m)

I9ve attached our co-sell requirements checklist and a template for marketplace SKU mapping. Can you upload your full SKU CSV to the Drive link below before EOD Monday so Ben and our listings team can validate ahead of the call?

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMA-MutualActionPlan

Best,
